subject: Upcoming Company Picnic - RSVP Required!
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce our upcoming company picnic on Saturday, June 12th at the local park. The event will include games, food, and a chance to socialize outside of the office. Please RSVP by Friday, June 4th so we can ensure we have enough food and activities for everyone. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Your Name] HR Department
